	return <IconInfoCircle aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" size="16" />;

	return <IconCircleCheck aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" size="16" />;
}

function AlertTriangleIcon() {
	return <IconAlertTriangle aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" size="16" />;
}

function AlertCircleIcon() {
	return <IconAlertCircle aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" size="16" />;
}

export function AlertSpecimen() {
	return (
		<Stack gap="8">
			<SpecimenSection
				description={
					"Presents critical messages across five semantic tones with token-backed colors and contrast."
				}
				primary
				title="Semantic variants"
			>
				<Stack>
					<Alert variant="default">
						<AlertIcon>
							<InfoIcon />
						</AlertIcon>
						<AlertTitle>Default alert</AlertTitle>
						<AlertDescription>
							Standard operational feedback using surface and neutral content
							tokens.
						</AlertDescription>
					</Alert>

					<Alert variant="info">
						<AlertIcon>
							<InfoIcon />
						</AlertIcon>
						<AlertTitle>Information note</AlertTitle>
						<AlertDescription>
							Informational update with guidance on relevant system changes.
						</AlertDescription>
					</Alert>

					<Alert variant="success">
						<AlertIcon>
							<CheckCircleIcon />
						</AlertIcon>
						<AlertTitle>Deployment complete</AlertTitle>
						<AlertDescription>
							All services were updated successfully without downtime.
						</AlertDescription>
					</Alert>

					<Alert variant="warning">
						<AlertIcon>
							<AlertTriangleIcon />
						</AlertIcon>
						<AlertTitle>Storage threshold</AlertTitle>
						<AlertDescription>
							Database capacity has reached 85% utilization.
						</AlertDescription>
					</Alert>

					<Alert variant="error">
						<AlertIcon>
							<AlertCircleIcon />
						</AlertIcon>
						<AlertTitle>Connection failed</AlertTitle>
						<AlertDescription>
							Unable to establish connection to the remote cluster.
						</AlertDescription>
					</Alert>
				</Stack>

				description={
					'Interactive alerts should use role="region" with aria-labelledby to provide polite navigation landmarks.'

					role="region"
					variant="default"

						<InfoIcon />
					</AlertIcon>
					<AlertTitle id="interactive-alert-heading">
						Update available
					</AlertTitle>
					<AlertDescription>
						A new software release is ready to install. Review changelog before
						proceeding.
					</AlertDescription>
					<AlertAction>
						<Button size="sm" variant="outline">

"use client";

import {
	Combobox,
	ComboboxChip,
	ComboboxChips,
	ComboboxChipsInput,
	ComboboxCollection,
	ComboboxEmpty,
	ComboboxItem,
	ComboboxList,
	ComboboxPopup,
	ComboboxValue,
	Field,
	FieldLabel,
	Stack,
} from "@mizen-labs/ui";

const tags = [
	"Design",
	"Engineering",
	"Product",
	"Marketing",
	"Research",
	"Support",
];

export function MultipleCombobox() {
	return (
		<Stack gap="4">
			<Field>
				<FieldLabel>Team tags</FieldLabel>
				<Combobox
					defaultValue={["Design", "Engineering"]}
					items={tags}
					multiple
				>
					<ComboboxChips>
						<ComboboxValue>
							{(values: string[]) =>
								values.map((tag) => (
									<ComboboxChip key={tag}>{tag}</ComboboxChip>
								))
							}
						</ComboboxValue>
						<ComboboxChipsInput placeholder="Add tag…" size="sm" />
					</ComboboxChips>
					<ComboboxPopup>
						<ComboboxEmpty>No tags found.</ComboboxEmpty>
						<ComboboxList>
							<ComboboxCollection>
								{(tag: string) => (
									<ComboboxItem key={tag} value={tag}>
										{tag}
									</ComboboxItem>
								)}
							</ComboboxCollection>
						</ComboboxList>
					</ComboboxPopup>
				</Combobox>
			</Field>
		</Stack>
	);

page.code:
"use client";

import {
	Button,
	Field,
	FieldDescription,
	FieldLabel,
	Inline,
	Input,
	Page,
	PageDescription,
	PageHeader,
	PageTitle,
	Section,
	SectionDescription,
	SectionHeader,
	SectionTitle,
	Stack,
	Switch,
} from "@mizen-labs/ui";

export function PageSettingsExample4() {
	return (
		<Page width="narrow">
			<PageHeader>
				<PageTitle>Workspace settings</PageTitle>
				<PageDescription>
					These settings apply to everyone in the workspace.
				</PageDescription>
			</PageHeader>
			<Section aria-labelledby="settings-general-title">
				<SectionHeader>
					<SectionTitle id="settings-general-title">General</SectionTitle>
				</SectionHeader>
				<Stack gap="4">
					<Field>
						<FieldLabel>Workspace name</FieldLabel>
						<Input defaultValue="Northstar" name="name" />
					</Field>
					<Field>
						<FieldLabel>Workspace address</FieldLabel>
						<Input defaultValue="northstar" name="slug" />
						<FieldDescription>
							People open the workspace at this address.
						</FieldDescription>
					</Field>
				</Stack>
			</Section>
			<Section aria-labelledby="settings-notifications-title">
				<SectionHeader>
					<SectionTitle id="settings-notifications-title">
						Notifications
					</SectionTitle>
					<SectionDescription>
						Choose what reaches your inbox.
					</SectionDescription>
				</SectionHeader>
				<Stack gap="2">
					<Field>
						<FieldLabel>
							<Switch defaultChecked name="mentions" />
							Mentions and replies
						</FieldLabel>
					</Field>
					<Field>
						<FieldLabel>
							<Switch name="summary" />
							Weekly summary
						</FieldLabel>
					</Field>
				</Stack>
			</Section>
			<Inline justify="end">
				<Button variant="ghost">Cancel</Button>
				<Button variant="brand">Save changes</Button>
			</Inline>
		</Page>
	);
}
